messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: S2 - Multiple customers reporting external egress failures from us-west-2, AZ-b. Automatic alert triggered by CloudWatch NATGatewayUnreachable metric. Please acknowledge if oncall.
Maria S.: acked — I'm oncall for infra. pulling logs now.
Kevin L.: I'm here too, starting network checks, will verify route tables and NAT health.
Tara P.: grabbing recent terraform diff from PR #3248, looks like a route-table association change rolled out at 01:12 UTC.
Alex R.: seeing spike in 502s from ingress LB -> upstream checks failing to reach registry for image pull. likely egress.
Maria S.: initial impact: ~12% of requests for hosted customers in us-west-2 fail to fetch external APIs, some customers report timeouts. no data plane errors in other regions yet.
Kevin L.: running quick probe: `curl -v --interface eth0 http://ifconfig.co` from a busted pod -> times out.
Kevin L.: `aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter Name=state,Values=available --region us-west-2` shows 2 nat gateways in AZ-b but health checks flapping for one.
Tara P.: PR diff snippet: ```diff
- aws_route_table_association.app_subnet_b
+ aws_route_table_association.app_subnet_b (replaced)
```
Tara P.: looks like association got re-pointed to a route table that has no NAT route (was for private internal traffic). probable human-led terraform change.
Maria S.: tagging for priority. Kevin, can you confirm whether reverting association restores egress?
Kevin L.: I can patch route back. Propose to add a temporary explicit route for 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0a1b2c3d in rtb-0a11b22 before doing a full terraform rollback. lower blast radius.
Alex R.: customers: several SaaS tenants impacted for outbound webhooks and metrics shipping. estimate ~600 requests/min failing, some retries kicking load elsewhere.
Maria S.: creating short incident bridge, pinging oncall-manager to join.
oncall-manager: joining bridge on Zoom in 2 min. forwarding to exec-notify after initial mitigation.
Kevin L.: running command to inject route: ```bash
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0a11b22 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --network-interface-id eni-03f... --region us-west-2
```
Tara P.: careful — create-route to eni may not be right for nat gateway; use `--nat-gateway-id nat-0a1b2c3d`.
Kevin L.: corrected, running: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a11b22 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0a1b2c3d --region us-west-2`
deploy-bot: deploy event detected: terraform-apply-prod at 01:11:34 UTC triggered by tara.p — plan summary: 3 changes, 2 replaces.
Maria S.: I'm pausing any further deploys in us-west-2. tagging: deploy-freeze. :no_entry_sign: 
Kevin L.: route replace completed. testing from affected pod: `curl -sS http://ifconfig.co` -> returns public IP, success.
Alex R.: can confirm image pulls resumed on a few hosts, traffic normalizing. metrics show error-rate dropping.
Maria S.: rolling back the route-table-association change in terraform is safer long-term. Tara, can you revert the PR?
Tara P.: reverting PR now, pushing `terraform apply -target=aws_route_table_association.app_subnet_b` with plan to re-associate to original rtb-0b22c33.
Tara P.: apply finished, state updated. verify: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --route-table-ids rtb-0b22c33` shows association back to subnet-b.
Kevin L.: NAT gateway that showed flapping appears overloaded because traffic routed to wrong RTB forced hairpin through nat in AZ-c. capacity mismatch. we've set up explicit route to correct NAT while rollback completes.
Alex R.: customer impact: majority customers restored, still seeing intermittent 503s for 2 customers behind heavy webhook load (we're retrying).
Maria S.: status update to SRE channel and CSMs: partial outage in us-west-2 AZ-b affecting outbound network calls; mitigation applied by re-associating subnet with correct route table. Next steps: full rollback completed, monitoring for 30m, RCA to follow.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1868004321, severity: 2, started_at: 1868004321.
Maria S.: handoff: I'll hold pager for recovery window. Kevin, please follow up on NAT capacity sizing and add auto-scaling for NAT usage or add redundant NATs in AZ-b. Tara, please lock down terraform reviewer process to prevent route-table swaps without network review.
Kevin L.: will open a follow-up task: `NET-452` with proposed mitigations (redundant NATs, route table change guard).
Tara P.: will create PR template gate and require `netops/approve` for route table association changes.
Alex R.: collecting customer-facing blurb for support: "We experienced partial egress disruptions for services in us-west-2 AZ-b starting 01:12 UTC. Services are restored. We are investigating root cause and will follow up"
Maria S.: thanks team. last check: monitoring shows error rates back to baseline for 25m. closing on-call bridge in 10.
oncall-manager: good job. handoff to Maria for postmortem. please include timeline, terraform diff, commands run.
Maria S.: Handoff note: incident still open for RCA. next update by 1868006723.
Kevin L.: logging all commands and outputs to the incident ticket.
Maria S.: closing thread for now, will update when RCA draft ready. :white_check_mark:
